disks.description: List of disks to manage with hd-idle. Each entry specifies device path, idle timeout, and optional parameters.

idle_time.description: Idle time in seconds before spinning down the disk. Must be >= 10. Set to 0 to disable spinning down for this disk.

spin_down_test.description: If true, hd-idle will test the device's ability to spin down before enabling idle monitoring (useful for devices that misreport status).

user.description: User to run the hd-idle daemon as (if running in daemon mode).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for daemon mode. Defaults to /var/run/hd-idle.pid if omitted and daemon mode is used.
